metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Cal Brickwell
records.biography_en: He tries to rebuild HyperNorm certainty one approved rectangle at a time.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The wall is correct. The room is missing.

records.name: Nell Fairweight
records.biography_en: Her building weighs inconvenient cards until a difference can be charged for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Fairness is available in three approved sizes.

records.name: Perry Sealmark
records.biography_en: The Men in Black encourage his useful distinction between sealed and suspicious.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The seal has passed inspection. Its contents remain theoretical.

records.name: Cora Beadline
records.biography_en: She makes the approved pattern repeat, then hides one uneven bead for luck.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Her act of rebellion measures six millimetres.

records.name: Rafe Drainclear
records.biography_en: He clears black censorship goo from the drains and is told that the blockage is a policy.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The policy has reached the second floor.

records.name: Otto Cargo
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory promise the shipment belongs here; Otto stamps the feeling of relief.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The destination was decided after arrival.
